Subject: Next step: 30-min demo — choose demo lane (exec / ops+sec / infra deep-dive)

Hi Anika — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + suggested next step to get your stakeholders the right view of Redwood.

Recap (very short):
- You’re focused on getting predictable latency and lower per-token cost for customer-facing assistants.
- Security and data residency are blockers for procurement.
- Two engineering folks (infra + platform) will want a technical deep dive; a separate exec-level stakeholder will want a concise cost/ROI view.

To make the 30-minute session useful, please pick one of the lanes below — each is a 30-minute block and has a slightly different attendee list and outcome. I’ve marked our suggested owners so we bring the right people.

Option 1 — Executive summary (best for decision-makers)
- Focus: cost/latency tradeoffs, deployment modes, high-level SLA and pricing options
- Suggested attendees: Exec (you), VP Product (you or delegate)
- Redwood owners: Ethan (sales), Marissa (product)
- Outcome: mutual action plan and next procurement steps

Option 2 — Ops + Security (recommended if procurement requires security evidence)
- Focus: VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2 evidence and integration path
- Suggested attendees: Security engineer, Cloud/Infra lead
- Redwood owners: Marissa (security handoff), Priyom (solutions eng)
- Outcome: security checklist and evidence handoff (we’ll bring a short runbook)

Option 3 — Infra deep-dive (technical 30 min)
- Focus: runtime behavior, batching/latency, KV cache, perf numbers on your expected seq lengths
- Suggested attendees: Lead infra engineer, platform engineer
- Redwood owners: Priyom (technical lead), Marissa (runtime)
- Outcome: action items for a 60–90 min follow-up if needed

Proposed time windows (all in ET):
- Wed Apr 14 — 10:30–11:00 
- Wed Apr 14 — 15:00–15:30 
- Thu Apr 15 — 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt. If you pick Option 2, please cc the security engineer (we can loop them into a short pre-read).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (stub) — I’ve attached a one-page MAP that maps lanes to next steps.

Thanks — Ethan
Ethan Park
